trust_decision.summary: matchFileSnapshot trusts its caller-supplied filePath to already be a confined snapshot path; at the pinned commit no decision is made anywhere and the value goes straight to fs.writeFileSync/mkdirSync, while the published fix inserts exactly one decision at the top of the function by resolving against projectRoot and prefix-checking it.

landing_point.why: the advisory names matchFileSnapshot directly; this exported function takes filePath and hands it unmodified to fs.existsSync/mkdirSync/writeFileSync so an engineer reading only the summary opens this file first.

O3_reason_to_dismiss: NodeSnapshotEnvironment deliberately supports an absolute snapshotDir (src/assertions/snapshot-environment.ts:73-75, covered by tests/unit/snapshot-improvements.test.ts:348-353) and its filepaths come from the runner's test-file list rather than from a user-facing snapshot argument, so a solver can argue confinement belongs only to matchFileSnapshot.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: An absolute snapshotDir is a supported configuration that intentionally resolves snapshot files outside the test tree; an over-broad fix that confines every snapshot write to the project root (e.g. also guarding NodeSnapshotEnvironment.saveSnapshotFile) would break that feature.

O6_input_shapes: absolute path outside the project root (e.g. /tmp/outside-project.snap) -> rejected
relative path traversing above the project root (../../../tmp/evil.snap) -> rejected
relative path inside the project root -> allowed
absolute path inside the project root -> allowed (fix tests pass tmpDir as root)
path equal to the project root itself -> allowed (fix.diff:21)
non-existent nested subdirectory inside the root (root/subdir/new.snap) -> allowed, parents created

O8_uncovered_routes.route: SnapshotClient.loadSnapshots(filepath) stores any filepath and saveSnapshots() writes it through NodeSnapshotEnvironment.saveSnapshotFile -> fs.writeFileSync + mkdir -p, with no root confinement at all
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: absolute snapshotDir is a supported feature and the path is supplied by the runner's test-file list, not by the snapshot assertion API the advisory names
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: 1 file away in the same directory (src/assertions), separate snapshot implementation

O8_uncovered_routes.route: SnapshotManager.cleanup() resolves a snapshot path and NodeSnapshotEnvironment.removeSnapshotFile calls fs.unlinkSync on it unconfined
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: cleanup only deletes runner-generated snapshot paths and the advisory is about arbitrary file write, not deletion

O8_uncovered_routes.route: matchSnapshot()/writeSnapshotFile() creates __snapshots__ next to whatever stack frame is found and writes it with no containment
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: the path is derived from the test file's own location, so there is no caller-supplied input to traverse with
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: same file, separate path producer (getSnapshotFilePath at src/assertions/snapshots.ts:442-469)

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a root-confined saveSnapshotFile (or a projectRoot option on NodeSnapshotEnvironment) that mirrors the matchFileSnapshot check
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: the class already takes a configurable snapshotDir and is documented as part of the snapshot API (docs/architecture.md:92-93); a maintainer mirroring the published fix would add the same knob here.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: confinement of writeSnapshotFile / matchSnapshot to the directory of the declaring test file or the project root
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: matchSnapshot writes snapshot files through the same fs calls and would get the same hardening in a follow-up commit.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a realpath/lstat-based helper that rejects a path which is inside the root lexically but escapes through a symlink
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: the published check is a plain string prefix compare, so a reviewer worried about links (or about a relative projectRoot, which the published check rejects wholesale) would centralise a resolver in a path-safety helper.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: root confinement applied to obsolete-snapshot cleanup before unlink
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: the cleanup path is built from the same resolveSnapshotPath output and is the natural companion of the write-side guard.

O9_family: CWE-22 path traversal in a file-snapshot writer (arbitrary file write)

O10_build.toolchain: Bun (bun test, bun build, bun.lock, bunfig.toml) plus tsc --emitDeclarationOnly, driven by the Makefile
O10_build.project_tests: tests/unit/snapshot-matchers.test.ts covers file snapshot match/create/overwrite and update mode; tests/unit/snapshot-improvements.test.ts covers snapshot header, obsolete cleanup, snapshotDir resolution and escaping; run with `bun test tests/unit` (bunfig.toml enforces 98% coverage thresholds)

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: inside matchFileSnapshot reject any filePath that is absolute or contains '..' and stop there, leaving NodeSnapshotEnvironment.saveSnapshotFile, removeSnapshotFile and writeSnapshotFile unconfined.

out_of_scope_notes: Coverage reporters write to a caller-configured outputPath with no confinement (src/coverage/reporters/json.ts:39-40, src/coverage/reporters/lcov.ts:116-117); that is a separate configured-output feature, not the snapshot sink, and was not pursued.
